notes.title: Demo update - Skateboard now available 🛹
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is almost here! To celebrate, we’ve unlocked the Skateboard in the demo. The 'car' is available from the start—no unlocks needed!

Jump in, give it a spin, and share your thoughts on Discord. And don’t forget to wishlist! 🚗🛹❤️

notes.title: Demo update - New tricks 🛹
notes.notes:
We've updated the multiplayer demo with awesome new tricks!

➡️ Wheel grabbing tricks! Grab your wheels while mid-air 🛹
➡️ Trick score balancing 🏆
➡️ Small improvements and bug fixes 🛠

Because of the rebalancing of tricks scores we also have reset the highscores. 

Let us know what you think in Discord and don't forget to wishlist! 🚗❤️

notes.title: Multiplayer demo update
notes.notes:
We've updated the demo with some awesome new features!

What's new?
➡️ Skatepark mode! Hang out online and attack the leaderboards together 🛹 
➡️ More car customizations! 🖌️ Gain experience, level up and unlock all customizations
➡️ Enhanced multiplayer experience! 🤼 Seamlessly join other players mid-game or hang out in Skatepark mode
➡️ Lots of small improvements and bug fixes 🔧 

Let us know what you think in the Discord and don't forget to wishlist! 🚗❤️
